core_categories: Digital Healthcare Platform; Online Doctor Consultations; Appointment Booking; Medicine Delivery; Diagnostic Tests; Practice Management Software
specialty_focus: Practo is an integrated digital healthcare platform that connects patients with healthcare providers. It offers online consultations, appointment bookings, medicine delivery, diagnostic tests, and practice management software for clinics and hospitals. It does not deal in wearable medical devices.
